transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call our waste closeout meeting to order. As I understand it, we have twenty-four drums of solvent waste from the recent line-cleaning operation secured in the hazardous-waste cage, and our temporary storage permit for those drums expires this Friday. Before we can move toward final approval, I need both the waste coordinator and the production supervisor to report your current records and any required controls. I'd also like to discuss whether this material meets our approved recovery specification, since plant policy favors solvent recovery when it does. Let's start with the waste coordinator — can you walk us through your current records for these drums?

transcript.text: Good morning, Mara. I have the laboratory classification report for these drums, but I need to flag a records issue before I walk through the results. The report was received yesterday, but a laboratory-system outage prevented it from being uploaded to the waste log. I can share the classification breakdown now, and I'll work on getting the report formally logged as soon as the system is back online. I also want to note that plant policy requires documented treatment for every drum removed from the cage, so I'll need to make sure we have the proper documentation in place before any drums are moved.
